correctness.rationale: For all integers m,b>=2 the exact damaged graph is defined. The deletion-star cofibration at z0 is analyzed via Q=Delta(A) union c cones(Ind(mK2)), Z=A_disc*Delta(Brest), and their intersection K_(2m,b-1). The link splits as S1 wedge (2m-2)(b-2) S2. A fundamental-cycle basis makes its H2 inclusion primitive inside the canonical Mayer–Vietoris H1(J), giving c=(b-1) S2 and c S^m as integral homotopy wedges. The m=2 coincident-degree boundary is included. An independent enumerator recomputed finite mod-two homology for 11 cases; the integral and all-parameter proof is not extrapolated from those checks.

originality.rationale: Direct inspection of the relevant full text of Carnero Bravo arXiv:2307.13271 identifies a complete-join theorem, credited as the intact baseline, not a missing-edge classification. Barton–Brown–Pike arXiv:2011.01735 gives acyclic enumerators, not this topological assertion. Published indexed single-edge-defect results for bipartite or multipartite graphs have distinct graph classes and/or invariants. The claimed primitive attachment for a matching–independent near-join is not implied by those conclusions. Searches cannot exclude unindexed equivalents.
residual_risks: Published full-text sources behind two highly related index entries were inaccessible; comparison there is limited to indexed scopes and the independently specified graph classes.
Unindexed or differently phrased treatments of graph joins with exactly one missing cross-edge might exist.
A general result on all forest complexes of single-edge-defective joins could imply this special case, although no such stronger statement was found.

value.rationale: The graph family has two unbounded natural parameters and models failure of a joining edge between a matching and an independent shore. The exact fault homotopy has (b-1) spheres each in dimensions 2 and m, whereas the credited intact family has (2m-1)(b-1) S2 and b Sm; the second-degree rank collapses without dependence on the matching size. The proof isolates the primitive rectangular-cycle attachment responsible for the abrupt homotopy response; this is not a routine enumeration or a relabeling.
